activationRequirements: At least multiple distinct viewpoints per landmark, not just one web photograph.
A reviewed held-out local evaluation set with no near-duplicate leakage.
A real on-device visual embedding or classifier model and a matching reference index.
Measured unknown-scene rejection and calibrated match thresholds.
Every additional image must have documented reuse permission and provenance.
